items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: We was playing the Pearl Theater in Baltimore... Harry Carney finally found a little part (humming), and made the third part.

ctx.x: What years do you suppose you started copyrighting tunes? Maybe this could be looked up.
No. Well, now, Duke -- you see, Duke did a lot of things. Duke, he put Harry Carney's name on "Rocking in Rhythm. Harry Carney never wrote a thing in his life, you know. That's true. I'm not kidding.
You mean Harry didn't have a -- Why did Duke put his name on it?
